notes.subject: נשכבה
notes.rationale: KJV/YSV/YLT ritim em i singsing bilong wok ('mipela i slip'), ASV/JPS/BSB ritim em i laik bilong ol ('yumi slip'); mi bihainim ASU/JPS.

notes.subject: yumi/mipela
notes.rationale: Hebrew i no gat pronaun bilong taim bilong wok cohortative; Tok Pisin i nilim 'yumi' — em i tok bilong man i tokim olgeta.

notes.subject: karim rupim
notes.rationale: תכסנו literal em i 'karim samting i karim oli' — kuvim; 'rupim' em i klostu piksa bilong kuvim olgeta.

translation: Yumi slip long sem bilong yumi, na sem nogut bilong yumi i karim rupim yumi olgeta, bilong olsem: long Yahwe Elohim bilong yumi, mipela i wokim sin, mipela na ol papa bilong mipela, stat long taim bilong yangpela yia bilong mipela i go inap long dispela de, na mipela i no harim tok bilong Yahwe Elohim bilong mipela.

tokens.gloss: na … i karim rupim yumi olgeta
stat long taim bilong yangpela yia bilong mipela
